The clearest positioning setup in the day: +51% since the August print, 1.4% under the 52-week high and ABOVE the $50.5 average sell-side target, a whisper 60% ahead of consensus, and the option market paying +31.8 vol points for 25-delta puts with put/call OI 3.9 - into a name that sold two of its last three beat-and-raises by 12-13% and only paid when the raise far exceeded the beat off a much lower base.

US organic is 1.4% year to date against a reaffirmed mid-single-digit full-year organic guide that implies high-single-digit US growth in H2, WSP said Americas conversion was 'more measured' and fell 8.9% over two sessions, and a new CEO's first quarter with a December strategy day is the natural moment to trim; the conservative margin range and Arcadis's double-digit US water are the offsets on a name whose median print move is 2.3%.

H1 adjusted EPS of R$4.58 needs R$3.11 a quarter to reach the bottom of the R$10.80-11.40 guide against Brazilian previews of R$2.30-2.40, so a cut or a 'below range' statement is close to forced while the US$ FY consensus ($2.27) still sits ABOVE the guide's translated top; the 2027 guide was set before the runoff, 15-90 day NPL jumped to 6.00% from 4.97%, and guidance is the line that cost this name 19.4% in March and 6.7% in August.

An honest non-result: the ~$1.1bn fair-value gain is computable by anyone from 43,514 BTC and the public price, and everything that could move the stock - the CEO's promised discount-closing update at the first-ever call, a possible related-party Elektron deal in stock at 0.63x NAV, and the overnight bitcoin tape - is two-sided with no document giving a sign.
